description: Pairwise alignment whose gap scores differ by direction and by position: Biopython 1.88 PairwiseAligner's twelve properties {open,extend}_{internal,left,right}_{insertion,deletion}_score (insertion = a gap in sequence1 = the target, deletion = a gap in sequence2 = the query; the deprecated names target_left_open_gap_score, query_right_extend_gap_score, ... and every aggregate such as open_gap_score, end_extend_gap_score, left_gap_score, insertion_score are accepted too, more specific names override general ones). gapScores = name -> value, Biopython convention (an open score is the score of the FIRST gap position, extend the score of each further one; all <= 0 up to Open + Extend <= 0). A gap run that begins the alignment is a left (start) run, one that finishes it a right (end) run, every other run is internal; unnamed slots use the interior gapOpen / gapExtend of this tool (Seqeron convention: a gap of length k scores gapOpen + k*gapExtend, linear when affine = false: k*gapExtend). A left / right score of 0 is a free overhang (the semi-global family); endGaps (comma-separated flags FreeStart1, FreeEnd1, FreeStart2, FreeEnd2, or the names Fitting, Overlap..., All) makes the matching slots free unless gapScores names them. mode = global (default), semi_global (the result is tagged SemiGlobal when an end is free) or local (a local alignment never starts or ends in a gap: only the internal scores apply, as in Biopython's local mode). affine = false is the linear program (the per-position score is the extend value; open is ignored). With matrix = BLOSUM62 | PAM250 | EDNAFULL ... residues are scored by that table and every gap score may be fractional (exactScore = the real score). Coordinates: a free start / end run is an overhang outside startPosition / endPosition, a priced one is inside. No new dynamic program: the existing linear / Gotoh / Smith-Waterman cores take the gap scores as a function of the matrix position. VERIFICATION: Biopython 1.88 PairwiseAligner score on 1000 random pairs (scalar, EDNAFULL, BLOSUM62; global / local; linear / affine; free, equal and independently priced ends) equal on 998; the two others are a Biopython linear Needleman-Wunsch corner (its first column of the last row is charged the right score nA*right_deletion_extend, its own Gotoh routine the left score). Inputs above 25,000,000 dynamic-programming cells are aligned by the exact linear-space program (Hirschberg / Myers-Miller; the gap score of each sub-problem is resolved by its position in the whole matrix; the same rows as the full matrix, O(m + n) memory).

affine.description: true (default) = affine gaps (Gotoh), false = linear (per-position extend score).

match.description: Score for matching base (ignored when matrix is given).

mismatch.description: Score for mismatching base (ignored when matrix is given).

gapOpen.description: Interior gap-open score for slots not named in gapScores (Seqeron convention: added once per run; <= 0). May be fractional when matrix is given.

gapExtend.description: Interior gap score per position for slots not named in gapScores (<= 0). May be fractional when matrix is given.

gapScores.description: Biopython gap-score properties, name -> value (e.g. {"open_left_insertion_score": 0, "extend_left_insertion_score": 0, "end_deletion_score": -3, "open_gap_score": -5, "extend_gap_score": -1}); see the description for the accepted names.

endGaps.description: Optional free end gaps (comma-separated FreeStart1, FreeEnd1, FreeStart2, FreeEnd2 or None, Fitting, FittingSequence2, OverlapSuffix1Prefix2, OverlapSuffix2Prefix1, All); slots named in gapScores keep their score.

matrix.description: Optional substitution matrix: any built-in matrix by EMBOSS, NCBI or Biopython name - BLOSUM62, PAM250, EBLOSUM30 ... EBLOSUM90, EPAM10 ... EPAM500, BLASTP (BLOSUM62 with the residues U = selenocysteine, O = pyrrolysine and J = leucine / isoleucine, as blastp scores them), GONNET1992, JONES, DAYHOFF, MDM78, BENNER6 / 22 / 74, JOHNSON, RISLER, GENETIC, FENG, LEVIN, MCLACHLAN, RAO, STR (protein; the fractional ones are scored exactly) or EDNAFULL, EDNAMAT, EDNASIMPLE, ENUC.4.4, BLASTN, MEGABLAST, HOXD70, TRANS (IUPAC DNA); or THE TEXT of a matrix instead of a name: several lines in the NCBI / EMBOSS / Biopython data-file format (a header line of symbols, then one row per symbol: the symbol and its scores; # lines are comments; scores may be decimals). When given, match/mismatch are ignored, residues are scored by the published table (any protein or IUPAC symbol of the matrix; case-insensitive) and gapOpen/gapExtend may be fractional (the EMBOSS needle/water models: gapOpen = -(G - E), gapExtend = -E for -gapopen G -gapextend E). The result then also carries the real-valued exactScore.

errors.message: mode must be global, semi_global or local.
... must be finite with Extend <= 0 and Open + Extend <= 0
